Volume Control Client Exported Functions

group VCP_Client_Exported_Functions

Functions

bool vcs_write_cp(uint16_t conn_handle, T_VCS_CP_OP op, T_VCS_VOLUME_CP_PARAM *p_param)

VCS client write Volume Control Point.

vcs_client.h

If this API is called successfully, the Application will receive LE_AUDIO_MSG_VCS_CLIENT_CP_RESULT.

Parameters:

  • conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle.

  • op -- [in] Volume control point opcode: T_VCS_CP_OP.

  • p_param -- [in] Pointer to Volume Control Point parameter: T_VCS_VOLUME_CP_PARAM.

Return values:

  • true -- VCS client write Volume Control Point is successful.

  • false -- VCS client write Volume Control Point failed.

Returns:

The result of VCS client write Volume Control Point.

T_LE_AUDIO_CAUSE vcs_write_cp_by_group(T_BLE_AUDIO_GROUP_HANDLE group_handle, T_VCS_CP_OP op, T_VCS_VOLUME_CP_PARAM *p_param)

VCS client sends Volume Control Point by LE Audio group.

vcs_client.h

If this API is called successfully, the Application will receive LE_AUDIO_MSG_VCS_CLIENT_CP_RESULT. The parameter op can't be set to VCS_CP_SET_ABSOLUTE_VOLUME, VCS_CP_UNMUTE, and VCS_CP_MUTE. Application can call cap_vcs_change_mute and cap_vcs_change_volume instead.

Parameters:

  • group_handle -- [in] LE Audio group: T_BLE_AUDIO_GROUP_HANDLE.

  • op -- [in] Volume control point opcode: T_VCS_CP_OP.

  • p_param -- [in] Pointer to Volume Control Point parameter: T_VCS_VOLUME_CP_PARAM.

Return values:

  • true -- VCS client sending Volume Control Point by LE Audio group is successful.

  • false -- VCS client sending Volume Control Point by LE Audio group failed.

Returns:

The result of VCS client sending Volume Control Point by LE Audio group.
